name: Australian Strategic Materials Ltd
summary: Australian Strategic Materials Ltd engages in mineral evaluation activities in Australia. It holds 100% interest in the Dubbo Project that contains zirconium, rare earths, niobium, and hafnium located in central-western New South Wales, Australia. The company is also involved in breeding and grazing of sheep and cattles. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Burswood, Australia.
